tools.name: SkillSpector
tools.description: Security scanner for AI agent skills. Checks a skill for vulnerabilities, malicious patterns and security risks before it is installed, using static analysis and an optional LLM review.

tools.name: AI-Infra-Guard
tools.description: Red teaming platform that fingerprints AI infrastructure components against known CVEs and scans MCP servers, agent skills and agent workflows for risks. Also runs LLM jailbreak evaluations.

tools.name: Snyk Agent Scan
tools.description: Discovers agent components on a machine (agents, MCP servers, skills) and scans them for prompt injections and vulnerabilities. Formerly Invariant Labs' mcp-scan.

tools.name: MCP Scanner
tools.description: Python tool that scans MCP servers and tools for security findings, combining YARA rules, LLM-based analysis and the Cisco AI Defense inspect API. Runs as a CLI or a REST API server.

tools.name: Agentic Radar
tools.description: Security scanner for agentic workflows: analyzes agentic systems to show how they work and to find potential vulnerabilities. Can run in CI on every push.

tools.name: numbat
tools.description: Endpoint visibility for AI agent activity. Finds the agents on a machine and flags risky actions with CEL and YAML rules, such as a secret file read followed by egress. Shipped rules only monitor.

tools.name: ModelScan
tools.description: Open-source scanner from Protect AI that checks machine learning model files for unsafe code before they are loaded.

tools.name: picklescan
tools.description: Security scanner that detects Python pickle files performing suspicious actions, including models hosted on Hugging Face.

tools.name: Fickling
tools.description: Decompiler, static analyzer and bytecode rewriter for Python pickle files. Detects and analyzes malicious pickle and pickle-based files, including PyTorch files.

tools.name: NeMo Guardrails
tools.description: Open-source toolkit for adding programmable guardrails between application code and an LLM in LLM-based conversational applications.

tools.name: Guardrails
tools.description: Python framework that runs input and output guards in an AI application to detect, quantify and mitigate specific risks, with validators from Guardrails Hub.

tools.name: Purple Llama
tools.description: Meta's umbrella project of open tools and evals for building with open generative AI models, including the Llama Guard safeguard models and the CyberSecEval benchmarks.

tools.name: garak
tools.description: Generative AI red-teaming and assessment kit. Probes an LLM or dialog system for prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, hallucination and other weaknesses.

tools.name: PyRIT
tools.description: The Python Risk Identification Tool for generative AI: an open framework that helps security professionals and engineers find risks in generative AI systems.

tools.name: promptfoo
tools.description: CLI and library for evaluating and red-teaming LLM-based apps and agents.

tools.name: DeepTeam
tools.description: Open-source red teaming framework for LLM systems that runs locally, built on the DeepEval evaluation framework.

tools.name: Anamorpher
tools.description: Crafts and previews image scaling attacks against multi-modal AI systems: images that reveal a prompt injection only once they are downscaled. Covers bicubic, bilinear and nearest-neighbor.

tools.name: AgentDojo
tools.description: A dynamic environment to evaluate prompt injection attacks and defenses for LLM agents, from ETH Zurich and Invariant Labs.
tools.maintainer: ETH Zurich SPY Lab and Invariant Labs

tools.name: ADR (Agentic AI Detection and Response)
tools.description: Uber's toolkit for agent security: inventories agents and MCP servers on endpoints, records agent traces, and ships ADR-Bench, a benchmark of 17 agent attack techniques, with two-tier detectors.

tools.name: Giskard
tools.description: Python library for evals, red teaming and test generation on agentic systems. Its Scan mode probes an agent for prompt injection, jailbreaks, harmful content and other OWASP LLM Top 10 risks.

tools.name: Anthropic Sandbox Runtime (srt)
tools.description: Lightweight OS-level sandbox that enforces filesystem and network limits on any process without a container. Can sandbox agents, local MCP servers and bash commands. Beta research preview.

tools.name: E2B
tools.description: Open-source infrastructure for running AI-generated code in secure, isolated cloud sandboxes, controlled from JavaScript and Python SDKs.

tools.name: ToolHive
tools.description: Runs each MCP server in an isolated container with a minimal permission file and no local credentials. Adds access policies, encrypted secrets and network isolation. CLI, desktop app or Kubernetes.

tools.name: Agent Sandbox
tools.description: Kubernetes controller and Sandbox resource for running isolated, stateful workloads such as agent runtimes. Isolation comes from the runtime, such as gVisor or Kata Containers. Go and Python SDKs.

tools.name: nono
tools.description: Least-privilege sandbox for AI coding agents, with no container, VM or daemon. Hides SSH keys, cloud credentials and the rest of the disk from the agent. Delegated tools get their own policies.
